detaileddescription.para: Each enumerator is a PERMANENT bit position within the capability bitmap that the server reports. The platform note in each comment states on which platforms the capability is defined/meaningful; whether a given bit is actually SET at runtime still depends on that platform's build configuration. Bits are packed contiguously and are never renumbered or reused - a new capability simply takes the next free position.
